WATCHER-PURE_WATER.description: At the start of each combat, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Miracle[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. Up to [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Token[/gold] cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold] do not count toward your maximum [gold]Hand[/gold] size.
WATCHER-PURE_WATER.flavor: Filtered through fine sand and free of impurities.
WATCHER-PURE_WATER.title: Pure Water
WATCHER-HOLY_WATER.description: Replaces [gold]Pure Water[/gold]. At the start of each combat, add [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Miracles[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. Up to [blue]5[/blue] [gold]Token[/gold] cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold] do not count toward your maximum [gold]Hand[/gold] size.
WATCHER-HOLY_WATER.flavor: Collected from a time before the Spire.
WATCHER-HOLY_WATER.title: Holy Water
WATCHERREBALANCE-SHATTERED_LENS.title: Shattered Lens
WATCHERREBALANCE-SHATTERED_LENS.descript: Whenever you [gold]Scry[/gold], deal [blue]4[/blue] damage to ALL enemies for each card discarded.
WATCHERREBALANCE-SHATTERED_LENS.flavor: Every future rejected leaves another crack in the glass.
